versions.A: Built LLM-as-a-judge gating for a production Amazon Bedrock document-importance classifier: a larger LLM scores it on an EventBridge schedule, and fine-tuning runs only when those scores move past a threshold
versions.B: Automated retraining for a production classifier on Amazon Bedrock that rates research documents by importance, using a larger LLM as a judge on an EventBridge schedule and fine-tuning only when its scores move past a threshold
versions.C: Automated retraining for a production Amazon Bedrock classifier that rates research documents by importance: on an EventBridge schedule a larger LLM grades its ratings, and fine-tuning runs only when the grades shift past a threshold
